about_the_game:
Dive into a mind-bending puzzle adventure where gravity is your greatest tool and biggest mystery. Set on an abandoned space station adrift near a black hole, Graviton blends rigorous physics-inspired mechanics with surprising twists, inviting you to rethink how the universe operates.

As a scientist investigating the station’s forgotten history, you’ll wield five unique abilities to overcome obstacles:

  • Anti-Gravity: Flip gravity up or down at will, altering the movement of all objects around you—trust your physics intuition to navigate.

  • Anti-Matter: These objects defy gravity’s rules (opposite to normal matter), unlocking never-before-seen physical phenomena (available in the demo).

  • Magnetism: Pull metal objects to create paths; combining magnetism with gravity adds layers of complexity to each level.

  • Gravity Zones: Enter areas that auto-flip gravity—no manual control allowed. Plan your moves carefully before stepping in.

  • Mirror Clone: Cooperate with your anti-matter doppelgänger. It mimics your actions but desyncs due to terrain—use this to cross solo-impossible gaps.

Every puzzle rewards creative thinking, blending logic with wonder. Uncover the station’s secrets as you master a world where physics is reimagined.
